messages:
ash: Heads-up — filing a quick thread about the Console experiment setup edge I ran into with seeding + implicit fallbacks. can anyone confirm intended behavior?

maria: yep saw that too. repro steps?

ash: create experiment -> variants: A seed 5, B seed 20, leave total 25 (I was prototyping a staggered rollout). Console currently lets you save but routing ends up sending remainder traffic to the most recent variant instead of an explicit control. feels risky.

samir: oof. UI should require seed sum == 100 or a fallback selection. we talked about an implicit fallback during last sprint but I thought we agreed on 'implicit->control' not 'last variant'.

priya: from SRE side, automatic sends to last variant would bypass our canary guards / per-variant qps caps. that could blow up backend if last variant is heavy. we need explicit guardrails.

ash: exactly. current behavior: if total_seed < 100 and fallback empty, router picks variant with highest priority (which for new experiments is the one you created last). not great.

maria: quick proposal: Console should enforce one of: 1) require seeds sum==100, 2) require explicit fallback variant, or 3) auto-add a floating "control" variant that absorbs leftover traffic and is marked in UI. Preference: (3) because it's least surprising for product folks.

samir: +1 for auto-control but we need clear UX copy: "Control (auto) — receives unallocated traffic" and telemetry tag so metrics know it's auto-added.

priya: if we do auto-control, ensure router treats it like regular variant for quotas and telemetry. Also ensure our rollout policy still honors canary QPS cap.

ash: implementation notes: backend API currently accepts payloads like:```json
{
  "experiment_name": "pricing_copy_test",
  "variants": [ {"id":"A","seed":5}, {"id":"B","seed":20} ],
  "routing": { "sticky": true, "fallback": null }
}
```
We'd modify server to: if fallback==null and sum(seeds) < 100 then: create fallback variant id="control_auto" seed=(100-sum) and annotate metadata {"auto_control":true}. Router then treats it normally.

maria: can we also make Console show a readonly seed percentage for the auto-control so customers see the numbers? and an option to convert it to a named variant?

samir: yes should be editable after creation: "convert control_auto -> Control (edit name)". ensure we disallow reducing its seed below current allocation without warning.

priya: question about audit/logging: if auto_control is created server-side, ensure we emit an event: `experiment.autocontrol.created` with fields: experiment_id, created_by (system or user), auto_seed. We need that for incident triage.

ash: agreed, will add event. also want a console validation that warns if any variant has seed < 1% — tiny seeds are often misclicks. maybe we suggest seeding helpers: "quick canary: 1%, 5%, 20%".

maria: UX nit: when user drags variant sliders, if sum<100 we should show a floating help CTA: "Unallocated traffic will go to Control (auto) — click to edit". small copy change avoids surprises.

samir: routing question: for sticky routing we currently hash on user_id -> variant. if we create auto_control server-side after initial save, do we need to pre-hash existing users so they can remain sticky?

priya: hashing is deterministic on variant list order+ids. adding a new variant will change distribution if we don't keep a stable allocation algorithm. better approach: treat auto_control as reserved id with deterministic insertion that preserves existing assignments (i.e., don't reshuffle existing users). implement by assigning ranges on top of existing mapping.

ash: ok I can sketch algorithm: compute current cumulative ranges for seeded variants; append control range at end. existing user hashes in existing ranges unaffected. new users landing in control range go there.

maria: that works. also need to document in Console docs and in API changelog.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: experiment-service v2.14.0 to staging (contains autocontrol changes) :rocket:

ash: launching a staging PR in a few hours. will add unit tests around seeding math + router integration test for per-variant qps cap. tagging you @priya and @samir for review.

priya: I'll look at the QPS cap tests. also please add telemetry tag `variant.source=auto_control` so queries can filter.

samir: I'll update Console copy and add the Convert button in the variant editor.

maria: thanks team. leaving this for the sprint — putting followups in the experiment-ux ticket. :thumbsup:
